# Add Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The + (Add) folder is the PKM "inbox" space for new and incoming notes.

**Also known as:** Obsidian Inbox, Plus Folder

## Scope note

It's a pre-triage staging area before migrating into the heart of the PKM system (Ideaverse) in Atlas, Calendar, or Efforts.
